FY2025 free cash flow per share was $7.05 on $8.0 billion operating cash flow minus $2.3 billion capital spending. industry.structure: Wafer fab equipment is an oligopoly: Applied Materials, Lam Research, Tokyo Electron, and KLA dominate distinct process steps. High R&D, long qualification cycles, and installed-base service attach create entry barriers.
industry.share_shift: Applied Materials leads in deposition, etch, CMP, and packaging tools; Lam strong in etch/deposition; KLA in process control. AI/HBM investment favors leading-edge foundry and memory upgrades where AMAT has broad share.
industry.trend: WFE spending is cyclical but AI data-center build-out, high-bandwidth memory, gate-all-around, and advanced packaging are extending the current upcycle. China export controls remain the largest geopolitical swing factor.
